site-explorer {} — explore a website: design, content, layout, 3D / animation, SEO / indexability health, and produce a spec package that can be handed to an AI and developers

Usage
  site-explorer <url> [options]            one-step exploration (https:// may be omitted); produces the dashboard and the handoff package
  site-explorer <subcommand> [arguments]

Common
  explore  <url>   one step: crawl → design package → health check → 3D → database → dashboard → handoff package
  health   <url>   site health check (SEO, crawlability, links, performance, mobile, security, AI crawlers)
  handoff  <url>   same as explore, with the handoff package (handoff/) as the focus
  setup             set up the environment in one go: check Node, install dependencies, find a browser (downloaded only with your consent), smoke test
  framework <handoff folder> --to react|vue|astro|shadcn|all   convert the starter into a React / Vue / Astro project or a shadcn/ui theme
  login    <url>   log in by hand once and save the login state, then explore pages behind the login with --storage-state
  mcp               run as an MCP server (lets Claude Desktop, Cursor and others call explore / health / verify directly)
  verify   <handoff folder>   rebuild verification: starter vs the original, per-section similarity + difference images (--min-score as a threshold)
  diagnose <url>   why can this page not be read? (opens it once with the crawler identity and once with the browser's default identity and reports what it sees)
  doctor   [url]   diagnose the environment (every problem comes with a fix command)

Advanced
  motion   <url>   only the 3D / animation capture (AI-readable)
  crawl    <url>   only crawl
  design   <site folder>      only produce the design package (tokens)
  report   --site <folder>   only produce the dashboard
  compare  --a <folder> --b <folder>   compare two sites side by side
  history|db  list | search --lib three | history <host> | compare <idA> <idB>

Options (explore)
  --max-pages 6   --out ./explore-out   --no-motion   --no-health   --no-handoff   --no-db
  --no-link-check   --open | --no-open   --no-standalone   --wait 4000
  --json   --a11y   --verify   --framework react|vue|astro|shadcn|all   --storage-state f.json
  --fail-on high|critical|medium|low   --motion-pages 5   --headed

Global
  --lang zh|en     Output language (default Traditional Chinese; en = English, including reports, dashboard and handoff)

Every subcommand also accepts --help for its detailed usage.
